shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml
node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({scripts:p.scripts,version:p.version},null,2))\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"validated by\" src specs adrs | head -40
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
rg -n \"describe\\(|it\\(\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | tail -20
rg -n \"spec anchor|spec:\" scripts .lore | head -30"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"it\\(.*validated by|test\\(.*validated by|\\(\\[validated by\\]\\(.*spec\" src scripts | head -30
sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,100p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git log --oneline -5
rg -n \"inputSchema|validate|malformed|executor|rejection|tool\" README.md docs/adding-a-tool.md .specify/spec.md CHANGELOG.md | head -80
node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.dependencies)\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | rg \"it\\(\" && rg -n \"registry.test.ts#L\" specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git diff --check
git status --short'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "test: pin unknown tool errors" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
